summary: The change does what was asked, so the verdict is pass. It adds the full id 39962ed02fec9da2d87cd4a3e287121ed229cd0f to the end of `[history] exempt` in athena.toml and leaves the five existing entries as they were. Above the list it adds a comment, in the style of the comments already there, saying why the commit is exempt and naming the same remedy as ee4b0dd (D66) and f2a8453 (D70). It also adds a Fixed entry under [Unreleased] in CHANGELOG.md. No other file changed. I ran cargo clippy and cargo test, and both passed. I also ran `athena check --history`. So that check could not show whether the real main is green again. That still needs a CI run on main. The only other problem is a small formatting nit in the changelog.
